followup_decision.scope: New student seeds with the same synthetic teacher/domain; no new-domain claim.

teacher.definition: Tiny locally trained AR teacher, normalized over A/B at every prefix.

config.study: Training-only balanced-codec follow-up after encoder-collision diagnosis. Known seeds 0,4,7; only new seeds 8-12 determine gates. Prior stays empirical; soft TC uses training-frequency importance weights. No coefficient, architecture, update-count or gate tuning.

decoder_repair.selection: Uniform over distinct training observations; no validation/population weighting.

decision.interpretation: Pilot did not meet the fixed gates; no SCALE benefit established.

budget.note: All arms execute teacher alignment and soft TC computations with dynamic coefficients; shared teacher/calibration cost is charged equally. FLOPs are compiler estimates, not measured total hardware work.

limitations: One locally trained synthetic teacher, not an externally pretrained LLM.
PCA representation calibration, no exact operator transplantation or cross-size transfer.
Independent draws share the finite support; this is not held-out-domain language evaluation.
Soft training dependence and exact hard-code dependence are different distributions.
Enumeration grows exponentially and is capped at 4096 codewords.
No TPU, language-quality, latency advantage or training-compute saving is established.
